title: Purchasing Agent Disclaimer
content:
Purchasing Agent Disclaimer


This Purchasing Agent Disclaimer (“Disclaimer”) applies when you use the purchasing agent, order fulfillment, warehousing, parcel forwarding, inspection, packaging, or related services provided through our website ( “we,” “us,” or “our”).

By submitting or paying for a purchasing agent order, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to this Disclaimer, the  Terms of Service, the Prohibited Items Policy, and any other policies applicable to your order.

1. Our Role as Purchasing Agent

We acts solely as your purchasing and forwarding agent. At your request and based on the product information or link you provide, we may assist you with:

  • Placing an order with a third-party seller;
  • Paying the seller on your behalf;
  • Receiving and temporarily storing the product;
  • Performing basic visual inspection;
  • Packaging or consolidating parcels; and
  • Arranging domestic or international delivery.

Unless a product is expressly identified as being sold directly by us, we are not the manufacturer, brand owner, distributor, or seller of the product. The underlying product transaction remains between you and the relevant third-party seller.

2. Third-Party Product Information

Product titles, descriptions, images, specifications, prices, availability, size charts, materials, authenticity statements, warranties, and other product information are provided by third-party sellers or marketplaces.

We do not independently create or verify all such information and cannot guarantee that it is complete, accurate, current, or free from error. You are responsible for reviewing and confirming the product details before submitting your order.

Differences in color, size, texture, material, workmanship, packaging, or appearance may occur because of lighting, photography, screen settings, manufacturing batches, or information supplied by the seller.

3. Product Quality and Authenticity

We do not manufacture the products and do not provide any independent warranty regarding their:

  • Quality, durability, safety, or fitness for a particular purpose;
  • Authenticity, origin, or brand authorization;
  • Compliance with technical or safety standards in your destination country;
  • Intellectual property status; or
  • Compatibility, functionality, or performance.

Any brand name, trademark, logo, image, or product description displayed through We belong to its respective owner and does not indicate any affiliation with, authorization by, or endorsement from that owner.

If you purchase branded or potentially restricted products, you accept the risks associated with authenticity, intellectual property rights, customs inspection, seizure, return, or destruction.

4. Inspection Limitations

Unless otherwise stated, any complimentary inspection performed by us is limited to a basic visual check, such as apparent product type, quantity, color, size label, and visible external damage.

A basic inspection does not include professional authentication, laboratory testing, material verification, measurement of every dimension, functional testing, internal inspection, installation, washing, wearing, tasting, charging, powering on, or opening sealed retail packaging.

Certain differences or defects may not be discoverable during a basic inspection. Optional photographs, measurements, or value-added inspection services may also be subject to practical and technical limitations.

5. Orders, Prices, and Availability

Product prices, domestic shipping fees, service charges, seller promotions, exchange rates, and availability may change before the purchase is completed.

If the seller changes the price, requests additional payment, modifies the product, or reports that the item is unavailable, we may request your confirmation, require additional payment, substitute the item only with your authorization, or cancel and refund the affected portion of the order.

Once we have placed or paid for an order with the seller, cancellation or modification may no longer be possible. Any cancellation, return, or exchange will be subject to the seller’s rules and the Hiobuy Returns and Refunds Policy.

6. Shipping, Customs, and Import Responsibilities

International freight is generally not included in the initial product order amount unless expressly stated.

You are responsible for:

  • Confirming that the product may legally be purchased, exported, transported, and imported;
  • Providing complete and accurate recipient, address, customs, and declaration information;
  • Paying international freight, customs duties, import taxes, brokerage fees, storage charges, penalties, or other destination-country charges; and
  • Complying with all applicable laws and carrier requirements.

Customs clearance, delivery times, and final delivery are controlled by customs authorities, carriers, and other third parties. We cannot guarantee that a parcel will clear customs or arrive within an estimated delivery period.

A parcel may be delayed, opened, inspected, returned, confiscated, destroyed, or subject to additional charges. Responsibility for such events will be determined under applicable law, the selected carrier’s terms, and any shipping insurance purchased for the parcel.

7. Prohibited and Restricted Items

You must not use us to purchase or ship any item prohibited by applicable law, customs regulations, carrier rules, or the Hiobuy Prohibited Items Policy.

we may reject, cancel, hold, remove, return, or dispose of prohibited, restricted, dangerous, infringing, suspicious, or non-transportable items where permitted or required by law. Any reasonable costs arising from the user’s submission of such items may be charged to the user.

Acceptance of an order or receipt of an item at the warehouse does not guarantee that the item is lawful or eligible for international shipment.

8. Returns, Exchanges, and After-Sales Requests

Returns, exchanges, repairs, warranties, and after-sales requests are subject to the third-party seller’s policies, applicable marketplace rules, and our service policies.

We may assist with communicating with the seller but cannot guarantee that a seller will accept a return, provide a replacement, issue a refund, or cover domestic shipping costs.

You must inspect warehouse photographs and submit any after-sales request within the applicable time limit. Once a parcel has been shipped internationally, returning a product to the original seller may be unavailable or may require additional shipping, customs, and service fees.

9. Limitation of Responsibility

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for losses caused by:

  • Incorrect, incomplete, or misleading information supplied by a seller or user;
  • Product defects, counterfeit goods, seller fraud, or seller non-performance;
  • Normal manufacturing variations or defects not discoverable through the selected inspection service;
  • Customs actions, import restrictions, carrier delays, force majeure events, or changes in law;
  • A user’s violation of applicable law or Hiobuy policies; or
  • Indirect, incidental, special, or consequential losses arising from a third-party product.

Nothing in this Disclaimer excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded, including any applicable liability for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, or non-waivable consumer rights.

10. User Acknowledgment

By selecting “I agree” and submitting your order, you confirm that:

  1. You have legal capacity to enter into the transaction;
  2. You authorize us to purchase the selected product on your behalf;
  3. You understand that we are acting as a purchasing agent and is generally not the product seller;
  4. You have reviewed the product information and accept the risks of purchasing from a third-party seller;
  5. You understand the limitations of the inspection service;
  6. You accept responsibility for import compliance, customs duties, taxes, and destination-country requirements; and
  7. You agree to comply with the Hiobuy Prohibited Items Policy and other applicable service terms.

If you do not agree to this Disclaimer, please do not submit the order.
